# Code of conduct

Short version: be decent.

- Argue about code, not about people. "This allocation is unnecessary" is a
  review comment. "You clearly don't understand Rust" isn't.
- No harassment, slurs, or personal attacks anywhere in the project's spaces:
  issues, PRs, reviews, discussions, the IRC channel.
- Assume good faith. Most rough patches are honest attempts, and most blunt
  comments are just blunt.
- Music taste isn't a competition. Nobody's library gets graded here.

If someone's making the project worse to be around, email
andrew@zealsprince.com or contact me under @zealsprince literally everywhere
else ([zealsprince.com](https://zealsprince.com) has the links).
Reports stay private. Consequences scale from a warning to a ban, at the
maintainer's judgment.
